Photosynthesis (bio wk 6)
photosynthesis = how plants make glucose from CO2 + water using light energy
happens in chloroplasts. chlorophyll is the green pigment that absorbs light (mostly red + blue)
2 stages:
1) light-dependent reactions -> in thylakoid membranes. water split (photolysis), O2 released, makes ATP + NADPH
2) Calvin cycle (light-independent) -> in the stroma. fixes CO2 into sugar using ATP + NADPH
rubisco is the enzyme that fixes CO2 in the calvin cycle
limiting factors: light intensity, CO2 concentration, temperature
